title: High Chase D5 deep MAE combo AB
primary_question: For high-chase D5 post-entry failures, should deep early MAE be handled immediately, watched, or separated from mild failures?
primary_variable: stock sleeve only: D5 failure action split by MAE depth; combo/ETF/runtime fixed
fixed_assumptions: Unified stock+ETF runtime and account NAV are the execution truth
ETF sleeve is fixed within each same-window comparison
Stock universe, ranking, entry, costs, and combo allocator fixed except D5 post-entry failure behavior
Same-window B0 combo replay is the decision anchor

evidence.note: human report with same-window matrix, recent-period attribution, trigger sample audit, and decision
18-run same-window combo matrix with component exp ids and D5 reason counts
Docker hard-gate/full stdout; stderr contains only pg_provider date-parse warnings
drawdown-objective re-audit separating stock-leg drawdown repair from combo headline MaxDD
stock-leg-only drawdown acceptance audit; ETF and combo-level dilution excluded from decision
stock-leg-only integrated CAGR, MaxDD, Calmar, Ulcer, UPI, Sharpe, underwater, downside risk audit
stock-leg-only D5 trigger trade-path audit over 5/10/20/40 trading days
per-trigger future 5/10/20/40 day path returns and classification
stock-leg-only repair re-entry audit for D5 mixed/sold-too-early samples
per-sample buy-back/candidate-layer audit after D5 half-sell
stock-leg-only D6 audit: whether original entry candidates reappear while D5 half positions remain held
per-sample raw _cand_idx visibility, post-held candidate surface rows, and held-filter verdict

key_findings: The full-cycle best variant is HC_D5_MILD_WATCH_DEEP_IMMEDIATE_DAY10_COMBO: 1226 CAGR +0.44pp, Sharpe +0.0206, MaxDD +0.06pp, Calmar +0.0132 versus same-window B0.
The same full-cycle best variant does not fix recent behavior: 2025-2026 combo -2.88pp and stock leg -9.13pp versus B0.

HC_D5_IMMEDIATE_COMBO is the cleanest robust candidate: it improves Sharpe in all three windows and wins the 1626 main window, but its full-cycle return lift is small and recent 2025-2026 remains negative.
Deep-only watch is rejected: deep MAE failures placed into watch do not produce stable return improvement.
All-watch is rejected: it slightly helps drawdown in full-cycle but loses return and does not preserve trend-following discipline.

The useful research statement is not a baseline promotion; it is that mild failures may be watched, but deep failures should not be forgiven, and any live rule needs an outer regime/breadth enablement layer.

Drawdown-objective re-audit changes the ranking: HC_D5_IMMEDIATE_COMBO and HC_D5_DEEP_ONLY_IMMEDIATE_COMBO improve stock-leg MaxDD across three windows, while watch variants are not suitable as drawdown-factor candidates.

Combo headline MaxDD improvement is small because the full-cycle combo MaxDD window is a short 2015 crash window where D5 does not trigger; the stock-leg drawdown window is longer and shows clearer repair.

Per user correction, drawdown acceptance should be stock-leg-only for this rule: deep-only-immediate and immediate remain the only continuing candidates; watch variants are not stock-drawdown candidates.
Integrated stock-leg CAGR/drawdown audit ranks HC_D5_IMMEDIATE_COMBO as the most balanced candidate: three-window positive CAGR, MaxDD, Calmar, Ulcer, UPI, and Sharpe deltas.
HC_D5_DEEP_ONLY_IMMEDIATE_COMBO remains the cleaner pure drawdown candidate: stronger MaxDD repair but weaker Ulcer/UPI/underwater improvement than immediate.
Trade-path audit shows HC_D5_IMMEDIATE_COMBO has 14/27 effective drawdown-prevention triggers, but also 4 sold-too-early and 6 mixed-drop-then-rebound triggers.
Deep-only immediate narrows triggers to 12, but sold-too-early value share is still 19.7%, so it is not a no-sell-fly version.
The next research problem is repair re-entry after D5 half-sell, not further watch-day tuning.
Repair re-entry audit shows HC_D5_IMMEDIATE_COMBO has 0/10 mixed/sold-too-early samples bought back within 40 trading days.
Deep-only immediate has 1/6 bought back within 40 trading days, but it happened after the remaining half was fully stopped, so it is ordinary re-entry rather than top-up repair.
Candidate-layer rows are zero for target samples while remaining half positions are held, so the current system lacks an observable top-up repair path.

D6 entry-visibility audit shows the original entry layer often did see the same symbol again: HC_D5_IMMEDIATE_COMBO has 9/10 target samples and 33 raw entry events while half-held; deep-only immediate has 4/6 target samples and 14 raw entry events.
Those D6 raw entry events never surface into candidate_signals for the target symbols, confirming the blocker is provider-level held filtering rather than cash, ranking, or ETF/combo interaction.
The sold-too-early subset is the strongest restore/top-up candidate: immediate has 4/4 seen while half-held; deep-only has 2/3 seen while half-held.

audit.stderr_status: main stderr empty; guard/full stderr warning-only

decision.reason: Full-cycle best variant improves long-run metrics but weakens 2025-2026 stock leg; stock-leg-only drawdown re-audit supports immediate/deep-only-immediate as the continuing candidates; watch variants are not drawdown candidates.

next_actions: Design a restore/top-up OpenSpec AB: when a half-held D5 position re-enters the original raw candidate set, mark it as restore_candidate and test controlled restoration to the original target weight.
Do not tune watch-day10 further under the drawdown objective.
Keep this as research-only evidence; do not modify CN_STOCK_ETF_COMBO_BASELINE_V3.
